fullPassage: It would be hard to overstate how important meaningful work is to human beings \— work \①that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. Those most satisfied with their work \④are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, \⑤finding that those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.
